g.text: Toy renderer: 20 x 20-pixel images of a T-shaped spacecraft in 8 orientation classes (45 deg apart, +/-11 deg jitter). Numpy network 400-96-8 trained on 8 000
images per set. A: Sun fixed, black sky, no noise. B: random Sun angle, random gradient and blob backgrounds, blur, gain and noise. 'Real' test images (3 000
per point): Sun angle spread, textured Earth-limb background, blur, gain error and noise all grow with severity (0 = identical to A).
